objects.name: CyberAv3ngers
objects.description:
The [CyberAv3ngers](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1027) are a suspected Iranian Government Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC)-affiliated APT group. The [CyberAv3ngers](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1027) have been known to be active since at least 2020, with disputed and false claims of critical infrastructure compromises in Israel.(Citation: CISA AA23-335A IRGC-Affiliated December 2023)

In 2023, the [CyberAv3ngers](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1027) engaged in a global targeting and hacking of the Unitronics [Programmable Logic Controller (PLC)](https://attack.mitre.org/assets/A0003) with [Human-Machine Interface (HMI)](https://attack.mitre.org/assets/A0002). This PLC can be found in multiple sectors, including water and wastewater, energy, food and beverage manufacturing, and healthcare. The most notable feature of this attack was the defacement of the devices user interface.(Citation: CISA AA23-335A IRGC-Affiliated December 2023)

external_references.description: Source: International Strategic/Iran/Iranian-Affiliated Cyber Actors Exploit Programmable Logic Controllers Across US Critical Infrastructure.pdf

etda-threat-group-cards.description:
(CISA) The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI), Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA), National Security Agency (NSA), Environmental Protection Agency (EPA), and the Israel National Cyber Directorate (INCD)—hereafter referred to as 'the authoring agencies'—are disseminating this joint Cybersecurity Advisory (CSA) to highlight continued malicious cyber activity against operational technology devices by Iranian Government Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC)-affiliated Advanced Persistent Threat (APT) cyber actors.

The IRGC is an Iranian military organization that the United States designated as a foreign terrorist organization in 2019. IRGC-affiliated cyber actors using the persona “CyberAv3ngers” are actively targeting and compromising Israeli-made Unitronics Vision Series programmable logic controllers (PLCs). These PLCs are commonly used in the Water and Wastewater Systems (WWS) Sector and are additionally used in other industries including, but not limited to, energy, food and beverage manufacturing, and healthcare. The PLCs may be rebranded and appear as different manufacturers and companies.

misp-threat-actor.description: Cyber Av3ngers is an Iranian IRGC Cyber-Electronic Command-affiliated threat actor that targets internet-exposed operational technology and industrial control systems. Public reporting documents disruptive targeting of Israeli-made Unitronics PLCs and HMIs, broader critical-infrastructure targeting, and use of the IOCONTROL malware against IoT and OT devices.

APTIran has claimed responsibility for a large-scale campaign targeting Israeli critical infrastructure, asserting infiltration of government ministries, hospitals, universities, and financial institutions as retaliation for Israeli military operations. The group has leaked over 350,000 Israeli government login credentials and approximately 300 internal databases, while also threatening to create a 'zombie' network from infected devices. They have reportedly deployed ransomware strains such as ALPHV and LockBit as part of their offensive toolkit. Additionally, APTIran has made unverified claims of compromising Israeli water control systems and the state-owned food security agency Jordan Silos and Supply General Co.

misp-tidal-groups.description: CyberAv3ngers is a cyber actor group that has claimed responsibility for numerous disruption-focused attacks against critical infrastructure organizations, including an oil refinery and electric utility in Israel and water/wastewater utilities in the United States. According to a joint advisory released by U.S. & Israeli cybersecurity authorities in December 2023, CyberAv3ngers (aka Cyber Av3ngers or Cyber Avengers) is a “cyber persona” of advanced persistent threat actors affiliated with the Iranian Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC). The advisory detailed how suspected CyberAv3ngers actors compromised programmable logic controller (PLC) devices that were exposed to the internet and used the vendor's default passwords and ports, leaving defacement images and possibly rendering the devices inoperable. The defacement messages suggested that the group or affiliates might carry out attacks against other technological equipment produced in or associated with Israel.<sup>[[U.S. CISA IRGC-Affiliated PLC Activity December 2023](/references/51a18523-5276-4a67-8644-2bc6997d043c)]</sup>

objects.name: フランス、冷蔵設備への攻撃で15件以上の火災が発生、イランに帰属
objects.description: フランス政府は、10月11～12日夜に国内約700の小売拠点などを狙った冷蔵設備へのサイバー攻撃を、イラン革命防衛隊（IRGC）関連のサイバー攻撃部隊Shahid Kavehに帰属させた。 攻撃者は産業用冷蔵制御装置を侵害し、霜取り設定を高温に変更した。当局によると、食品損失は数千万ユーロ規模に上り、少なくとも15件の火災と重大な物的損害が発生した。 大手スーパーに加え、精肉店、食肉処理場、食品加工施設も影響を受けた。同時期には小規模水力発電設備のSchneider Electric製機器への攻撃も確認され、同じ活動に関連付けられた。 帰属の根拠には、過去の同部隊の手法に一致する産業機器への偵察、FOFAの利用、関連宣伝媒体CyberbanNewsによる攻撃の紹介、攻撃基盤に残されたペルシャ語の痕跡などが挙げられている。 フランスはイラン大使を召喚して抗議し、EUの追加制裁を提案する方針。今回の帰属は10月のフランス国内の攻撃に限られ、11月の欧州各国や血液保管施設への攻撃は帰属対象としていない。
objects.x_analyst_notes: 日次収集レコード daily-record--d9ec6dd35901f7e4030bc65e から取込。活動期間はレビュー済みの一次資料記載がある場合だけ設定し、ニュース公開日やIOC収集日からは推定しない。 reported_atは活動期間ではなく、レビュー済みの一次資料公開日。 主体判定: candidate。 レビュー: 採用。フランス外務省の帰属声明原文（2026-11-09付）を確認した。10月11〜12日夜の冷蔵設備へのサイバー攻撃を「l'unité cyberoffensive SHAHID KAVEH, affiliée au centre électronique et cyber du Corps des Gardiens de la Révolution Islamique d'Iran」へ帰属。Shahid Kaveh Groupは本プロファイルのscope: exactのalias（CISA共同政府勧告由来）であり、政府による帰属声明としてconfidence highとする。フランス国内700超拠点のスーパー等の産業用冷蔵制御装置が侵害され、霜取り設定の高温変更により火災（複数件）と数千万ユーロ規模の食品損失が発生。声明はCyberAv3ngers・Soldiers of Solomon等のペルソナ名を挙げていない（tech-memo要約のそれらへの言及は二次報道由来）。Emennet Pasargad（声明表記Emmenet Pasargad）は本攻撃へ寄与したとしてEUが2026年3月に制裁した実体として言及されるが、部隊間関係は示されておらず関係を生成しない（unknown-clustersのshahid-shoostariエントリの記録と整合）。同時期の小規模水力発電設備（Schneider Electric機器）への攻撃の言及は関連活動として説明に保持。EU広域の同種冷蔵設備攻撃（FBI/CISA勧告、帰属なし）はeu-refrigeration-attacksクラスタとして台帳に留め、本Activityはフランス政府が帰属した範囲に限る。破壊的影響（火災・物損）を主題とするためactivity_typeを自動値intrusionからdisruptive-activityへ変更。

The sectors that these PLCs can be commonly found in are water and wastewater, energy, food and beverage manufacturing, and healthcare. The most notable feature of this attack was the defacement of the PLCs' HMIs.(Citation: CISA AA23-335A IRGC-Affiliated December 2023)(Citation: Frank Bajak and Marc Levy December 2023)
